endpoints.summary: Retrieves detailed information for a UK postcode.
endpoints.description: Matches the postcode regardless of case or spacing. Returns 404 if not found, with a terminated property if the postcode was previously active.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: UK postcode to look up, with or without spaces.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves data for up to 100 postcodes in a single request.
endpoints.description: Send a JSON body with a postcodes array and Content-Type application/json. Postcodes that are not found have a null result. Also: Returns the nearest postcodes for up to 100 coordinate pairs in one request. Send a JSON body with a geolocations array. Results are sorted nearest first; invalid geolocations return a null result.

parameters.name: postcodes
parameters.description: Array of up to 100 postcodes to look up.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of attributes to include in each result object.

parameters.name: geolocations
parameters.description: Array of geolocation objects with longitude and latitude, maximum 100.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of postcodes to return for each location, must be less than 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, must be less than 2000.

parameters.name: widesearch
parameters.description: When true, extends search radius up to 20km, returning at most 10 results.

endpoints.summary: Returns postcodes matching a search query string.
endpoints.description: Also: Returns the nearest postcodes to a longitude and latitude pair. Each result includes a distance field in meters from the given coordinates.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query string.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Alias for q.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return, max 100.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude, a WGS84 value between -180 and 180.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, a WGS84 value between -90 and 90.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in meters, max 2000.

parameters.name: widesearch
parameters.description: Enables a wide area search up to 20km, returning at most 10 results; ignores radius and limit when true.

endpoints.summary: Returns a list of postcodes nearest to the specified postcode, ordered by distance.
endpoints.description: Returns a 404 if the input postcode is not found.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The postcode to search from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limits number of postcodes to return, max 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, max 2000.

endpoints.summary: Returns a list of postcodes matching the given partial postcode.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The partial postcode to match.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limits number of postcode matches to return, must be less than 100.

endpoints.summary: Returns a random postcode with all its available data.
endpoints.description: Optionally filter by outcode; an invalid outcode returns null.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: Filters random postcodes by outcode, e.g. CM8 or SW1.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves detailed information about a UK outward code.
endpoints.description: Matching is case-insensitive. Returns 404 if the outward code is not found.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: UK outward code, the first half of a postcode, e.g. BR8.

endpoints.summary: Returns the nearest outcodes to a longitude and latitude pair, ordered by proximity.
endpoints.description: Each result has the same shape as an outcode lookup.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude, a WGS84 value between -180 and 180.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, a WGS84 value between -90 and 90.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limits the number of outcode matches returned. Maximum is 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres. Maximum is 25000.

endpoints.summary: Returns a list of outcodes nearest to the given outcode, ordered by proximity.
endpoints.description: Returns 404 if the input outcode is not found.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: The outcode to find neighbours of, e.g. NW1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limits the number of outcodes returned. Maximum is 100.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres. Maximum is 25000.

endpoints.summary: Look up a GB place by its OSGB code.
endpoints.description: Returns 404 if the place is not found.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: OSGB code of the place, e.g. osgb4000000074564391.

endpoints.summary: Search for places matching a query string.
endpoints.description: Full-text match on primary and secondary names, falling back to prefix matching. Returns an empty array or up to 100 places.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query string.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Alias for q.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return, max 100.

endpoints.summary: Return a random place with all its data.
Look up a terminated (no longer in use) UK postcode.
endpoints.description: Matches inputs with or without the space and in any letter case. Returns 404 if not found.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The terminated UK postcode, e.g. E1W1UU.

endpoints.summary: Look up the Scottish Postcode Directory record for a Scottish postcode.
endpoints.description: Returns 404 if the postcode is not in the SPD; a 404 with the message "Postcode exists in ONSPD but not in SPD" applies when it is only in ONSPD.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The Scottish postcode, e.g. AB101XG.
